text: What made the cut on Straker's thigh? — his own knife, as he fell
id: q.thigh_cut=his own knife, as he fell
why: Watson raises the idea at ¶43 that Straker's own knife caused the wound in his convulsive struggles, Holmes calls it probable, and at ¶54 Inspector Gregory concludes he wounded himself in his fall. The question and its answer both appear in the story so far.
